manifest.title: The benchmark read: the published method and a detector told the lorry

params.microseisms: regional level, each ground its own realisation

finding: The benchmark's worlds read as images (P2-36's solver fields, a lorry 15 m west at the FTA's truck-over-a-bump level held at 69 Hz, Giza's microseisms, 8 independent grounds). At the real level the detector told the lorry separates cavities from controls with AUC 0.53 and names the world in 33% (chance 33%); the published map read blind, AUC 0.52 and 33%. With the cavity's difference amplified 1,000 times (a diagnostic), the told detector names 100% (p < 0.001, labels permuted within grounds), places the room against the room 6 m east in 16 of 16 and tells room from L tunnel in 16 of 16; the published map read blind names 33% (p = 1), separates cavities from controls with AUC 0.52 and centres its top places 9.8 m from the footprint (controls 9.5 m); its change against the no-cavity image, a diagnostic it never has, names 21%. The told detector recovers the imposed worlds at the positive control, so the experiment can reveal a real signal; what the published method does not read there it does not read in the image. Amplified levels are diagnostics, not physical predictions.
